title: Itaconate uptake via SLC13A3 improves hepatic antibacterial innate immunity
model: 293T cells with cBioITA itaconate biosensor, custom CRISPRi membrane-transporter library (7,441 sgRNAs, 1,241 genes)
contrast: cBioITA top 25% vs bottom 25% sort (1 vs 1 after summing technical re-reads)
paper_method: FACS enrichment screen; SLC13A3 identified as itaconate importer (no gene table deposited)
paper_calls: SLC13A3 as the dicarboxylate-transporter itaconate importer; validated functionally in hepatocytes and in vivo
barcs_calls: SLC13A3 #1 of 1,241, depleted in top (enriched in bottom), FDR 1.4e-85; only ABCG2 and RACK1 also at FDR 0.10
named_hits: SLC13A3 recovered as the #1 gene at FDR 1e-85
verdict: BARCS recovers the paper's sole screen hit, the itaconate importer SLC13A3, as the #1 gene by a wide margin (FDR ~1e-85), depleted in the high-cBioITA bin exactly as expected; agreement is complete for the one gene the screen reported.
